## What changed

Describe the user-facing outcome and the smallest implementation used.

## Specialist passes

- [ ] Lead Developer reviewed implementation and integration
- [ ] QA / Bug Hunter reviewed regressions and edge cases
- [ ] UI / Product reviewed this change, or it is not user-facing
- [ ] Database / Security reviewed this change, or it does not touch data/auth/security

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant desktop flow checked
- [ ] Relevant mobile flow checked

## Data / deployment

- [ ] No secrets or local env files committed
- [ ] RLS/authorization checked if data access changed
- [ ] Migration steps documented if schema changed
- [ ] Manual production steps documented below, or none are required

## Remaining risks / manual steps

None, unless listed here:
